description: Reference results, semantic (dual extraction) defense, 3 runs, 12 attacks and 20 clean texts. residual_ASR is the fraction of adaptive attacks that both landed and evaded the defense (lower is better). The surface defense catches plain attacks fully but collapses to near zero detection on adaptive attacks.
metric_note: base_ASR = attack landed on the standard extraction; detection = of landed attacks, fraction flagged; residual_ASR = landed and evaded; fp = clean texts wrongly flagged.
takeaway: Residual attack success falls from 28 percent on the weakest model to 0 percent on the strongest, across both providers. Detection of adaptive attacks scales with model capability. Numbers are from 3 runs and are noisy; treat them as trends.
